settlement_source: YouTube Charts (https://charts.youtube.com/US), Global location, as displayed from a New York IP address
settlement_variable: Artist's Global daily YouTube views on any single day in the Mon-Sun week; Yes if any day's value exceeds the threshold
timezone: unknown (YouTube Charts day boundary not stated; expiration 10:00 AM ET)
rounding: whole number by default per terms; Charts displays abbreviated figures (e.g. 15.2M) - displayed precision unknown
trading_close_vs_settlement: Sample week Oct 19-25: close 2026-10-27T14:00Z, expiration 2026-11-01T14:00Z (latest one week after period); can_close_early=1; settlement timer 1800s
early_close_or_void_clauses: Early close once criterion is met (Rule 7.2). Market Outcome Review (Rule 7.1) at Kalshi sole discretion; if value cannot be determined Kalshi decides payouts. Revisions after expiration ignored.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Series title 'Highest daily view count this week' vs market semantic 'above X at any point' (max over week)
Artist views cover all content attributed to the artist on Charts, not a single video
Values vary by location; resolution uses Global location viewed from NY IP
